result.topic_en: A faint pencil note in German on how to characterise a collineation, apparently ending in a cross-ratio-type product of segments equal to 1.
result.transcription:
Das Charakteristische der Collineation[?]
scheint am einfachsten so ausgedrückt werden
zu können[?] ... gerade[?]
Ist von A, B ... Linien[?], P, Q ... Punkte[?]
... ... ... die Linien[?]
a, b ... ... p, q ... entsprechenden[?]
Punkte[?] ... ... ... ...
... die Punkte[?] ... ... ...
... ...
$\frac{PA \cdot QB \cdot pb \cdot qa}{pa \cdot qb \cdot PB \cdot QA} = 1$

methods.what: Characterisation of a collineation by the invariance of a cross-ratio-type product of segments formed by points P, Q and their images p, q with lines A, B and their images a, b. The pairing of terms is uncertain.
methods.quote: $\frac{PA \cdot QB \cdot pb \cdot qa}{pa \cdot qb \cdot PB \cdot QA} = 1$
